title: astragalus zanskarensis subsp. oplites
intro: Astragalus zanskarensis subsp. oplites, commonly known as Zaskar milkvetch, is a plant species in the legume family, known for its medicinal properties. It is used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including its immunomodulatory and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help to prevent or treat conditions such as cancer, cardiovascular disease, and respiratory disorders. The therapeutic actions of Zaskar milkvetch include antioxidant, antibacterial, and antiviral activities, which may contribute to its potential health benefits. The bioactive constituents of Zaskar milkvetch include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
